summary: Tested 3 bug fixes: 1) PDF Generation - FIXED and working, 2) Base Year Sinks Display - Code correct (shows total in single row), 3) Sink Input Logic - Code correct (checks ANY reporting year). Fixed PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH environment variable issue.

feature_1_pdf_generation.description: PDF generation now works correctly using Playwright
feature_1_pdf_generation.fix_applied: Moved PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH environment variable to top of server.py (before any imports)
evidence: Backend logs show 'PDF generated successfully using Playwright'

feature_2_base_year_sinks_display.description: Code correctly shows sinks as single total row (not month-wise)
evidence: BaseYearEmissions.js lines 1334-1351: getSinksForBaseYear returns array, then calculates totalSinkReductions and displays single row
UI shows 'Total Carbon Sinks' with count and total value
No month-wise table rendering in the sinks section
feature_2_base_year_sinks_display.note: Sinks not visible in test because existing sink data has reporting_year: null (data issue, not code issue)

feature_3_sink_input_logic.description: Code correctly checks for sinks in ANY reporting year for facility
evidence: BaseYearEmissions.js lines 309-344: handleYearSelected checks beforeOldest && selectedEntity?.type === 'facility'
Line 313: facilitySinks = baseYearSinks.filter(sink => sink.facility_id === facilityId) - filters ALL sinks for facility, not just oldest year
Line 315: if (facilitySinks.length > 0) - shows sink input if ANY sinks exist

updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Added PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH at top of file, removed redundant setting inside function
context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF generation is now working with Playwright. The PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH must be set at the top of server.py before any imports. Base Year sinks display and sink input logic are correctly implemented. Existing sink data has reporting_year: null which prevents sinks from showing in base year view - this is a data migration issue, not a code issue.
rca_of_the_issue: PDF was downloading as .docx because Playwright couldn't find the browser executable. The PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH environment variable was being set inside the function (line 5299) but Playwright reads this at import time, not runtime. Fix: Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH at the top of server.py immediately after load_dotenv().
